changeSet.author: rawan
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwprocedure AS SELECT pr.id, pr.name, pr.code, pr.category_type, pr.is_appointable, pr.indications, pr.contraindications, pr.preparation_instructions, pr.recovery_notes, pr.is_active, pr.facility_id, pr.price, pr.currency, pr.created_by, pr.created_date, pr.last_modified_by, pr.last_modified_date, pr.billing_rule_id FROM public."procedure" pr;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwprocedure TO report_user;
